summary: Iteration 32 — end-to-end testing of 'Your 2026 on WanderMark' (Year-in-Travel) feature. Backend: 6/6 year-in-travel pytest cases pass; 26/26 moderation regression pytest cases pass (no regression from iter31). Live API verified against seed: memories=14, photos=40, countries=7, top_continent=Europe(11), busiest_month=March(3), oldest_memory=30 years ago (Eiffel Tower 1995), top_landmarks=Grand Canyon/Mt Fuji/Eiffel. Frontend (Expo Web, mobile viewport): YearInTravelBanner renders at top of /feed with testID 'year-in-travel-banner' and correct copy ('Your 2025 on WanderMark · Watch your recap'); /year-in-travel?year=2025 route mounts the Spotify-Wrapped carousel; all required testIDs present (year-in-travel-screen, recap-tap-prev, recap-tap-next, recap-close, recap-year-picker-open, recap-share-btn, recap-save-btn, recap-year-option-2024/2025); right-zone tap advances through 8 slides to the finale where Share + Save buttons are visible; left-zone tap navigates back; year-picker opens bottom sheet listing 2026/2025/2024/2023; no page errors or runtime exceptions in console. Notification routing for type 'year_recap_ready' verified by code review (notifications.tsx switch case routes to /year-in-travel?year={related_id}).
action_items: [OPTIONAL/UNRELATED] /app/frontend/app/notifications.tsx has a duplicate `case 'moderator_message':` in the switch (lines 132 & 140). The second case is unreachable because the first matches first. The intended behavior (open modal vs navigate to terms-of-service) is ambiguous — the modal-opening logic at line 140-143 will NEVER fire. Recommend removing the navigation case at line 132-139 if the modal is desired (modMessage state UI is already wired up below). This is pre-existing code, not introduced by year-in-travel iteration, but it affects the moderator-message UX.

[OPTIONAL/PERF] /app/backend/routes/year_in_travel.py 'new_countries' detection (lines 88-96) issues N sequential awaited find_one() queries (one per country). For users with many countries this is O(N) round-trips. Could be collapsed into a single aggregation pipeline, but acceptable at current scale (typical user <30 countries/year).
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotency of dispatch-notification is correctly implemented via `related_id=str(year)` lookup before insert — multiple concurrent calls in the same year cannot create duplicates (verified by test_dispatch_notification_idempotent).
no_memories short-circuit (lines 197-198) correctly prevents notifications for years with zero visits — verified for year=1990.
_aware() helper handles MongoDB tz-naive datetimes for oldest_memory comparison — does not repeat the iter31 moderation tz-naive bug.

Default recap year for dispatch (= current year - 1, Spotify Wrapped convention) differs from default for the GET endpoint (= current year). Documented in code comment line 25-27. Frontend banner hardcodes DEFAULT_RECAP_YEAR=2025, matching the dispatch default but not the GET default. This is intentional per PRD ('default year 2025') but worth flagging if the year rolls to 2026.
year_in_travel.py = 223 lines, single responsibility, well within 700-line guideline.
Banner's useEffect Animated.loop is properly created with a cleanup-friendly Animated.Value ref — no memory leak.
All interactive elements on year-in-travel screen and banner have the required data-testid attributes per the request contract.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (banner render, screen mount, 8-slide advance, year picker, share/save buttons, no errors)
